panel.introduction: Earth's Moon records evidence of our solar system's history in the form of impact craters, cooled lava landforms, ancient ice deposits, and more.

controls.label: Visible color
controls.description: NASA CGI Moon Kit display map from LROC color imagery. Small gaps are inpainted; beyond 70° north/south, lower-resolution monochrome LOLA albedo replaces missing color. The app reduces saturation and adjusts tone for display.
controls.title: CGI Moon Kit surface mosaic
controls.summary: Surface detail comes from LROC imagery. Small gaps are filled; monochrome replaces unavailable color near the poles.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Numeric LOLA elevation above a 1,737.4 km reference sphere. Colors represent −12 to +12 km; this gridded laser-altimetry product includes interpolation and does not displace the globe or represent current illumination.
controls.title: LOLA LDEM16 elevation model
controls.summary: Colors show height above or below a 1,737.4 km sphere. Shading reveals slopes in the archived laser-altimeter measurements.

controls.label: Crust
controls.description: Crustal thickness inferred from GRAIL gravity and lunar topography under assumed crust and mantle densities. This is an interior model shown with shaded relief, not a direct observation of the crust.
controls.title: Crustal-thickness model
controls.summary: Thickness is inferred from gravity and topography. The result depends on assumed rock densities, not direct underground imaging.

controls.label: Rock abundance
controls.description: Surface area covered by rocks, inferred from nighttime Diviner thermal measurements in 2009–2010. Color spans 0–2%; values above 2% share the brightest color. Patterned areas are outside ±60° coverage, missing, or physically invalid. This is a thermal model, not a photograph or a count of individual boulders.
controls.title: Rock abundance: LRO Diviner modeled rock-area fraction

controls.label: Silicate signature
controls.description: Diviner measures a thermal-infrared emissivity peak related to silicate composition. This 2021 map corrects viewing geometry and space weathering. Colors span 8.0–8.5 µm; values outside that range share endpoint colors. This is a composition proxy, not mineral abundance; residual topographic effects remain, especially above 50° latitude. Gray grid marks missing observations and latitudes beyond ±70°.
controls.title: Diviner Christiansen feature, 2009–2016

controls.label: Geology
controls.title: USGS unified global geology (2020 v2)
controls.description: USGS interpreted geologic units from the 2020 unified map, version 2 (1:5,000,000). Colors distinguish mapped units and their relative ages; they are not photographed surface colors. Small units may be absent at this display scale.
